heard: A tiny particle hit Earth with the force of a fast-pitched baseball. In October 1991, the fly's eye detector in Utah caught a visitor traveling at nearly light speed. Dubbed the Oh My God particle, it packed 320 xa-electron volts of kinetic energy. That is 47 million times more energy than any machine humans have ever built. Most assume such power requires a massive engine, like the jets of a supermassive black hole. But tracing its arrival path back reveals absolutely nothing in the darkness where it began. In 2021, the Amaterasu particle arrived from an even emptier cosmic void. These cosmic voids keep firing mysteries just like this.
differences: 'exaelectronvolts' heard as 'xa electron volts' after 'it packed 320'
